boss.what_they_did: Read the ticket, routed it to inventory first, pulled in accounting once the blocker turned out to be money, brought customer service in for the reply, and closed the ticket as resolved with the 2026-09-05 arrival in the note.

customer_service.what_they_did: Drafted the reply to Tauhid Zaman explaining the size S was out of stock and giving the restock date as conditional, not promised.

inventory.what_they_did: Found CC-TEE-WHITE size S at qty 0 (shortfall 1), identified Bulldog Print Co as the only apparel-reprint vendor and that invoice #501 was blocking them, then created PO #1 for 1 unit at $8.00 once the invoice cleared.

human_approvals.reason_shown_to_human: Invoice #501 is open and 3 days overdue as of shop date 2026-08-31. Paying now clears Bulldog Print Co's shipping block for the rush reprint CC-TEE-WHITE S; if it waits, the vendor remains unable to ship. Checking balance is $3,400.00, so this $840.00 request is affordable, leaving $2,560.00 if all requests are paid.

Queue PO #1 for the one-unit CC-TEE-WHITE size S restock on Ticket #101. The recorded PO total is $8.00, and the vendor is unblocked; if this waits, the shop cannot replenish the one-unit shortfall for the ticket.

human_approvals.reason_shown_to_human: Queue September rent for the Chapel Street shop, due 2026-09-02 (2 days from shop date 2026-08-31), to keep the lease current; if it waits past the due date, the shop risks falling behind on rent. The 12-unit restock would cost $264.00 against $152.00 of cash, so PO #2 was cancelled rather than left unfundable, and the club was told what the shop can and cannot do.

boss.what_they_did: Routed to accounting first because the ask was a price, took the partial-fill decision, and resolved the ticket with an honest 'partly no' rather than leaving it open.

customer_service.what_they_did: Drafted the counter-offer to the Yale AI Club: 8 available now, the other 12 unconfirmed, no discount promised that was not approved.
